subject: science
concept: Understanding how natural resources (fossil fuels, minerals, fresh water) are used and why some are limited
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Earth and Human Activity Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student sorts resource cards into 'renewable' and 'non-renewable' piles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a resource to a real-world use
exercise.abstract: Student explains why a given resource is limited or renewable

misconception_flags: assumes all natural resources are unlimited

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
